receipt_is_per_incident_or_per_route.note: three separate GETs of the same route minutes apart returned the same receipt and three different trace ids; measured directly against the local hop

subjects: ORD-0350: every confirmation row gets its own way back to the field it names
ORD-0353: give the create-failure screen a fold that holds measurements, not sentences
ORD-0353 witness: judge the fold's carriers by name, and keep the canary short enough to survive a slice

ref_drift_during_the_walk.what_i_did_not_do: no rebuild, no re-cut, no second walk; the readings stay bound to the bundle the chain served while I took them

walked_bundle_witness.what_this_is_not: this re-read proves which bytes sit behind that name on the local hop now; it is not a second reading of the public entry during the walk, and the walk-time public row was overwritten by my own re-run of r6_gen_check.py - named as an instrument fault

instrument_faults_of_mine.said: all eleven cities sit under the first group heading
instrument_faults_of_mine.signal: the same screen showed three names under 需联网 and seven under 未知, which cannot be true at once with 11 / 0 / 0
instrument_faults_of_mine.cause: I climbed ancestors and let the OUTERMOST heading overwrite the inner one
instrument_faults_of_mine.fixed_in: r6_dest_block_r3.cjs, which breaks at the first heading and now reports 1 / 3 / 7

instrument_faults_of_mine.said: citynexus-offline reported store names with a null row map
instrument_faults_of_mine.signal: store_names was ["journeys"] while rows was never attached before the promise resolved
instrument_faults_of_mine.cause: the counting callback resolved without assigning the collected rows

instrument_faults_of_mine.said: the server sent no receipt for the 404 leg
instrument_faults_of_mine.signal: the same route answered with error_receipt_id over a plain GET, and the leg carried content_type_on_the_page_side = null only over the tunnel
instrument_faults_of_mine.cause: my listener decided whether to parse JSON by the content-type header, which the public entry does not carry for that response
instrument_faults_of_mine.fixed_in: the listener now parses by body shape, and the leg reads CNX-FM7GYKRT / NOT_FOUND

instrument_faults_of_mine.said: the tunnel refused my connection, so I nearly reported the public entry as down
instrument_faults_of_mine.signal: DNS resolved and a direct TCP 443 succeeded in 574 ms while urllib failed with WinError 10061
instrument_faults_of_mine.cause: this shell exports HTTP(S)_PROXY=127.0.0.1:7892 where nothing listens
instrument_faults_of_mine.fixed_in: a no-proxy opener in every instrument here

instrument_faults_of_mine.said: the tunnel answered 401 to my first authenticated request
instrument_faults_of_mine.signal: the auth file holds 24 chars and no colon: it is user TAB secret
instrument_faults_of_mine.cause: I split on ":" and then on " ", so the whole line became the username; the line also reached my local console once - it was never written into any artefact, post or block
instrument_faults_of_mine.fixed_in: split on any whitespace or colon, plus an assert that refuses to write the artefact if either field appears in it

instrument_faults_of_mine.said: the two entries do not serve the same bytes
instrument_faults_of_mine.signal: that judgment flipped from true to false between two runs of my own scorer with no phone action in between
instrument_faults_of_mine.cause: I re-ran r6_gen_check.py to look for a re-cut, and it writes to its own output name, so the walk-time rows were replaced by a later reading taken after the tunnel had already gone 530
instrument_faults_of_mine.fixed_in: r6_walked_asset_witness.py pins the bundle by the name every browser pass recorded and re-reads those bytes over the local hop; the walk-time agreement is carried from r6_drift.json instead

boundaries: product bytes 0 changed; nothing repaired on the road; 0 writes to the authoritative line; no ref pushed that is not mine; no demo/reset; _live.db and _preview.db never opened; no git apply; no credential printed into an artefact; the four chain layers (:8693 / :4781 / :4782 / tunnel) only driven as a user or read by GET; own Chromium with a fresh context per cell; every screenshot written to an absolute path and re-verified
judgments_note: readings only; grading belongs to E. Each key is a computation over the fields named in this file and in the raw passes it scores
